        $r40_has_derivative_at(f, x0, slope1)
        $r40_has_derivative_at(f, x0, slope2)
        =>:
            slope1 = slope2
    by contra:
        ? slope1 = slope2
        slope1 - slope2 != 0
        |slope1 - slope2| > 0
        have epsilon R+ = |slope1 - slope2| / 3
        obtain delta1 from exist delta1 R+ st {$r40_derivative_delta_controlled(f, x0, slope1, epsilon, delta1)}
        obtain delta2 from exist delta2 R+ st {$r40_derivative_delta_controlled(f, x0, slope2, epsilon, delta2)}
        have radius R+ = finite_set_min(union({delta1}, {delta2}))
        0 < radius / 2
        have sample R = x0 + radius / 2
        sample = x0 + radius / 2 > x0
        sample - x0 = radius / 2
        |sample - x0| = |radius / 2| = radius / 2 < radius
        delta1 $in union({delta1}, {delta2})
        delta2 $in union({delta1}, {delta2})
        radius = finite_set_min(union({delta1}, {delta2})) <= delta1
        radius = finite_set_min(union({delta1}, {delta2})) <= delta2
        |sample - x0| = radius / 2 < radius <= delta1
        |sample - x0| = radius / 2 < radius <= delta2
        have difference_quotient R = (f(sample) - f(x0)) / (sample - x0)
        |(f(sample) - f(x0)) / (sample - x0) - slope1| < epsilon

        |slope1 - difference_quotient| = |difference_quotient - slope1| < epsilon
        |slope1 - slope2| <= |slope1 - difference_quotient| + |difference_quotient - slope2| < epsilon + epsilon = 2 * epsilon
        2 * epsilon = 2 * (|slope1 - slope2| / 3) = (2 / 3) * |slope1 - slope2| < 1 * |slope1 - slope2| = |slope1 - slope2|
        |slope1 - slope2| >= |slope1 - slope2|
        not |slope1 - slope2| < |slope1 - slope2|
        impossible |slope1 - slope2| < |slope1 - slope2|
